title: General Tso's Chicken
description: A flavorful Chinese-inspired dish with crispy chicken in a savory sauce.

ingredients.item: Chicken thighs with skin and bones

steps: Rub cornstarch all over the chicken thighs.
Pour oil into a skillet and heat it.
Using tongs, carefully drop the chicken into the hot oil and fry until crispy.
Add garlic and ginger to the pan and cook until fragrant.
Prepare the sauce by combining Chinese Dark soy sauce, ketchup, pineapple juice, vinegar, brown sugar, and red chili flakes.
Pour the sauce into the pan with the chicken and cook until heated through and coated.
notes:
Adjust chili flakes to taste for spiciness.

Source: https://www.facebook.com/share/r/17TjatWwyQ/

Nutrition: Serving 1 plate · Calories 350 kcal · Fat 15 g · Saturated fat 3 g · Unsaturated fat 12 g · Trans fat 0 g · Cholesterol 80 mg · Sodium 700 mg · Carbs 40 g · Fiber 2 g · Sugar 12 g · Protein 25 g

not_healthy: Skin-on thighs are deep fried in oil, so it's high in fat.
Brown sugar, ketchup and pineapple juice make the sauce high in sugar.
Dark soy sauce adds a lot of sodium.
